title: Your own tools
intro: Your own tools: the assistant uses them only when it works for you. Add one from the catalog or enter a server address, then press Test.
onlyYou: Only you can use these. Nobody else, not even the owner, can see or use them or their keys.
nextChat: New or changed tools show up in your next new chat.
name: Name
useSignIn: This server asks me to sign in (OAuth)
removeBody: The assistant stops using it in your new chats, and its saved key is deleted.
pasteHint: After you allow access, the browser ends on a page that may not load. Copy that page's whole address and paste it here.
signInDone: ✓ Signed in. Press Test to check it.
catalogEmpty: No catalog servers can be added here.
notConfigured: Your own tools need each person to sign in with their own account (multi-user setup).
limit: You can add up to {limit} servers.
